h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karawal Nagar

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karawal Nagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Karawal Nagar

c: Parks in Karawal Nagar, in North East Delhi, are small and closely surrounded by houses, so every square metre has to work hard. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to RWA parks, schools, community centres and parks under the Municipal Corporation of Delhi in Karawal Nagar. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,130 km away, and reach Delhi by road.

Combination machines are the answer for a small colony park, since one frame gives two or three exercises. A set of two or three combination stations covers most of the body. Delhi's summers are very hot and winters bring smog and fog, so morning and evening hours change with the season. We fix the machines through our installation team or a dealer in north India. Measure your park and send photos for a layout drawing.

items.q: How many machines fit in a small colony park?
items.a: Often two or three combination stations. Each frame gives two or three exercises, so a small park can still cover the whole body. We check the fit on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can an RWA order outdoor gym equipment directly?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park size and photos. We will prepare a layout drawing and quote for the RWA to review and approve before we manufacture.
Yes. We send the equipment from our factory in Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India.
